content.short: Swap 1,000+ coins with Changelly, which compares rates across 20+ providers and sends the result straight to your wallet.
content.description: Changelly has been swapping coins since 2015 without asking users to open a trading account. You pick two of more than 1,000 assets, Changelly checks rates across a long list of exchanges and liquidity sources, and the output goes directly to your own wallet. Fiat purchases go through partners such as MoonPay and Simplex. Changelly PRO adds order-book trading, and Changelly PAY handles merchant checkout. Users can choose a fixed rate to avoid price changes during a swap, and businesses can plug in its exchange API, fiat ramp API or affiliate programme.
content.meta: Swap 1,000+ coins at aggregated rates with funds sent straight to your own wallet. Explore Changelly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
